title: City Council Regular Meeting
motion: to Approve the S-Lot Preliminary Plat for the Alabama Plat A Subdivision at 51 Alabama Drive with the findings and conditions of approval: 1 The applicant shall prepare a final subdivision plat to be reviewed and approved by the City Engineer, Fire Marshal, and City Council. 2 The applicant shall comply with all requirements from the City Engineer, Building Official, and Fire Marshal. 3 The applicant shall obtain duty to serve letters for water and sewer prior to the approval of the final subdivision plat. 4 The applicant shall provide evidence that courtesy notices have been sent to Dominion
